simple.meaning: קֹמֶץ (qômets) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a grasp , i.e. handful.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 41:47. The surrounding context includes family line, offering, altar, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֹמֶץ (H7062) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קֹמֶץ (qômets) / H7062 is traced through Genesis 41:47, Leviticus 2:2, Leviticus 5:12, Leviticus 6:8 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

majorEvents.label: Offering
majorEvents.evidenceText: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

majorEvents.label: Offering
